title: Al-Inshiqaq 84:6-10 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Inshiqaq and the sifat of strength
source: Written for quran/y6 lesson 10 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Inshiqaq 84:6-10 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 10. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ (٦) فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ (٧) فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًۭا يَسِيرًۭا (٨) وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًۭا (٩) وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ (١٠)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
He will be judged with an easy account
And return to his people in happiness.
But as for he who is given his record behind his back,

keywords.def: a book; here a person's record of deeds

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Inshiqaq 84:6-10 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 84:6-10 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 84:6-10 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Write two things you can do this week that you would be happy to see in your book.
questions.a: For example: pray on time; help a parent without being asked.

questions.q: Contrast 84:7 to 9 with 84:10 in one sentence.
questions.a: Some receive their record in the right hand and return happy; others receive it behind their backs.

questions.q: The one who receives the book in the right hand will have ...
questions.a: A) an easy account. 84:8: 'He will be judged with an easy account'.

questions.q: Al-Inshiqaq 84:8: «فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Everyone is working hard towards something. 84:6 says we are all labouring towards our Lord. What does that mean for your day?
questions.a: Every effort leads to meeting Allah; so we make our efforts good. Some will receive their book in the right hand, others behind their backs (84:7 to 10).
